subject: Discarded single-segment reuse trial in hosted source-set hashing
claim: The trial retains one structurally validated response between region digests and calls the existing range hash API directly. It reduces response reads in the measured three-segment input from 13 to 3 while preserving all 11 digests. Output bytes match on both hosts. Complete packaging improves by less than 2% in single observations, while isolated Windows execution is slightly slower with essentially unchanged working set. No useful performance gain is established; the production source was restored and no tools were promoted.

38 direct source-set cases: both tools accept identical small valid output and reject usage, output alias, truncated plan/response, oversized response, wrong segment offset, out-of-range region, and each of 11 corrupted digests. Every rejection preserves the manifest sentinel and writes no chunks.

limitations: Negative optimization result, not an implemented redesign improvement. The candidate source and harnesses are ignored diagnostic artifacts identified by hashes; production source, WVB and native tools remain unchanged.

One before/after observation on each host. Windows and Debian packaging trials overlapped on the same physical host. The after-wrapper additionally preserved its small metadata and bundle response inputs for direct diagnosis. No regression threshold or statistically meaningful speedup is claimed.

Isolated Windows source-set execution measured 20344 to 20818 ms and sampled peak working set 17915904 to 17887232 bytes. The small difference is not evidence of a memory improvement. Linux peak memory was not measured.

The initial trial rejected extra files in a historical retained image checkpoint before packaging. A private snapshot of only its declared manifest, fragments and checkpoint passed the unchanged complete-identity validator. The original directory was preserved. Wrappers ran against the private snapshot, not the cache directory.

The paired-host tests use preserved native images and bootstrap tools; they are not full cold compiler preparation or repository qualification. The source-set phase still spends about 20 seconds validating and publishing this workload; hashing arithmetic or reuse of independently valid digest products merits investigation.

Debian direct cases completed; Windows direct malformed cases were not repeated after the optimization was discarded. Existing broad linker, bootstrap, ABI, OS and complete qualification owners were not run because no implementation change remains.
All construction and trial commands used explicit short deadlines within the ten-minute local development budget. The earlier 60-minute foreign-binding baseline was not repeated.
